summary.headline: Comet Omens in the Zodiac Mansions
summary.text: Judgments of comets in the twelve zodiac signs according to the sages of India, describing omens of plague, war, famine, political upheaval, weather, and social disorder from appearances in Aries through Capricorn. Specific predictions concern Rome, the Berber regions, nobles, astrologers, soothsayers, crops, livestock, and the duration of effects.
